ax: What is the file or entitlement for: setting type, making other work, dressing a game or platform account, keeping personal media, or holding a registered name or token?
key: 1. Is it a letter design used to set text? → Fonts & typefaces
2. Is it a file bought to make other work (artwork, presets, patterns, 3D models, sounds, AI weights)? → Creative assets
3. Is it an item, currency or pass kept in a game or platform account? → Game & platform items
4. Is it a book, recording, video or photo held as a file or locker entitlement? → Personal media files
5. Is it a registered name or a blockchain token? → Domains & tokens
Precedence: a token for a game item is a Game item NFT (step 5) while the same item inside the account is step 3; a program that uses the files → I1.
